_meta.purpose: Subscription services for the HoopsMatic How to Watch guide. Replaces data/services.json in jsierrahoopshype/nba-watch-guide.

unmapped_broadcaster_codes.NBCSN: 30 games in the NBA schedule feed. Deliberately not mapped to any service: the original NBC Sports Network shut down in 2021 and what this code refers to in 2026-27 is unconfirmed. These games render TBA until verified.
unmapped_broadcaster_codes.Telemundo: 10 games. Spanish-language coverage. Deliberately not counted as coverage for an English-language reader; show it as a separate note on those games.

_meta.carries_note: carries lists the broadcaster codes as they appear in cdn.nba.com scheduleLeagueV2.json: ABC, ESPN, NBC, Peacock, Amazon, NBA TV. Entries with carries_verified false must not be trusted for coverage maths until checked.

services.name: ABC (over the air)
services.billing_note: Free with an antenna in range of a local ABC station. A one-off antenna purchase is typically $20 to $50.

services.name: NBC (over the air)
services.billing_note: Free with an antenna in range of a local NBC station. A one-off antenna purchase is typically $20 to $50.

services.name: ESPN Unlimited
services.billing_note: Raised from $29.99 on September 17, 2026. Annual plan $319.99. Includes ESPN on ABC. The Disney+, Hulu and ESPN Unlimited bundle is $35.99 a month and stayed at that price through the increase.

services.name: Peacock Premium
services.billing_note: Raised from $10.99 on August 18, 2026. Annual plan $129.99. The cheaper Select tier at $8.99 carries no live sports and does not work for NBA games. Premium Plus is $19.99.
services.carries_check: Whether NBC's NBA games are also streamed live on Peacock, and in which markets, is unconfirmed. Until checked, Peacock counts only for games the feed codes as Peacock.

services.name: Prime Video
services.billing_note: Standalone Prime Video, with ads. A full Amazon Prime membership at $14.99 a month or $139 a year also includes it. The Ultra add-on for ad-free and 4K is $4.99 a month on top.
services.carries_check: Confirm that live NBA games are included on the $8.99 standalone Prime Video tier and not limited to full Prime membership.

services.name: NBA League Pass
services.billing_note: League Pass Premium is $24.99 a month and adds three concurrent devices, commercial-free in-arena streams and offline viewing. Season-long billing is also sold and runs through the end of the regular season. Out-of-market games only: national and local broadcasts are blacked out live.
services.carries_check: Deliberately empty. League Pass covers games with no national broadcaster that are outside the reader's market, which the rules block handles, not the carries list.

services.name: NBA TV
services.billing_note: Included at no extra cost with a League Pass subscription bought on NBA.com. Also carried inside some live TV packages. No confirmed standalone monthly price.

services.name: YouTube TV
services.billing_note: Base plan, 100+ channels, unlimited DVR, three simultaneous streams. ESPN Unlimited is unlocked in the ESPN app for subscribers.
services.carries_check: Local channel lineups vary by market and NBA TV carriage is unconfirmed. Verify before counting this toward coverage.

services.name: Hulu + Live TV
services.billing_note: With ads, after a 3-day free trial. Price for new subscribers as of September 23, 2026; anyone who signed up earlier moves to it on their first bill on or after October 21, 2026. Includes Disney+ and ESPN.
services.carries_check: Local channel lineups vary by market. Verify before counting this toward coverage.

services.name: Sling TV (Orange + Blue)
services.billing_note: Orange alone is $45.99 and carries the ESPN family. Blue alone is $45.99 and carries NBC in some markets. Local channel coverage is limited, so many subscribers pair it with an antenna.
services.carries_check: NBC availability depends on the market and ABC is not carried. Verify per market before counting this toward coverage.

services.name: Fubo
services.billing_note: Essential plan. Regional sports fees are added in some markets and are not optional. Does not carry the Warner-owned channels.
services.carries_check: Lineups vary by market and Fubo has had carriage disputes affecting NBC. Verify before counting this toward coverage.

services.name: DirecTV
services.billing_note: Choice plan, which is the cheapest tier carrying regional sports networks and therefore the relevant one for local NBA games. Entertainment is $89.99 without RSNs, Ultimate is $124.99, and a pared-down Sports + News plan is $55.99. Regional sports fees may apply.
services.carries_check: Which RSN a given market gets, and whether NBA TV is included, varies by plan and market. Verify before counting this toward coverage.

league_pass_blackouts.national: Nationally broadcast games cannot be watched live on League Pass and become available at 6am ET the next day.
league_pass_blackouts.local: Games televised locally in your area cannot be watched live on League Pass and become available three days after the game.
league_pass_blackouts.zip_check: The NBA publishes a zip code checker on its League Pass page for market-specific blackouts.
